If you are participating, I shall see this game to its conclusion.

A shame that she left. Watching her struggles would have proven amusing.

Running away after recognizing me? How cowardly.
You tease me with the possibility of seeing such a beauty naked, and then you leave me in the dust? Despicable.

Arriving and leaving without saying a word? How rude, peasant.

Running away? Royalty should never second guess themselves in such a cowardly way.
Good riddance. Mine game has no place for somber commoners in it.
Gone, huh? How regrettable, such madness could have proven amusing.
Gone without a trace. Or at least, that's how it appears...
Hmph. I suppose this activity is not for the faint of heart.

Much like the sun, not all are brave enough to stand alongside mine radiance.
Hopefully, this game can alleviate my boredom. My life has become too uneventful as of late.

Rejoice, commoners! I have chosen to bless you all with my presence in this boorish game of yours!

As expected, my innate blessing shines through once more.

Being pushed this far already exceeds my expectations. But I'm still far from being defeated yet.
A strategically simple, yet charming contest. No wonder it is popular amongst the common folk.

This, too, is war. Fought with naught but cards and wits, but war nonetheless.
People here tend to be different from those from Lugnica. The novelty is interesting, though a commoner remains a commoner nonetheless.
Obviously, I will employ every strategy in order to win. Only those with no pride in themselves can accept loss as a possibility.
Strength is not all that humans possess in order to realize their wishes. Beauty, too, is an oft forgotten weapon.

This place isn't worthy of mine presence... and yet, I shall elevate it.

Even at the brink of the precipice, mine legs shan't stumble.

Being associated with such mediocrity is almost insulting.

...It couldn't be, could it?

In this moment, you and I are all that matters. Leave everything behind, and give me a challenge I'll never forget!

Of course. The more ambition a person has, the more interesting that person is, generally speaking.

Do you really think that hand is going to cut it at this point?
I shall admit that you fought well, commoner. But you will fall before me, as did all the rest.
You face me now, peasant. Think very carefully about your next move.

Oh, you were the one to whom I gifted a piece of my attire. As I expected, it elevates you.
Everything in this world was made for my convenience. That means I do not wish for a predictable victory.

I have a good presentiment about this place. Here, I might find a diamond amidst the rabble.

Is the prize supposed to be something to strive for? It seems to be mostly symbolic... Yet that does not mean I shall simply allow mineself to lose.
Such a delightful selection of marvels to enjoy... ah, I don't know who I want to see lose next.

Playing such a boorish game in a dark alleyway... I know this shall work in my favor in the end. But I do find the process amusing.
If this location is meant to impress me, it has thoroughly failed. I could buy it in a whim, if I so desired.
Five have been assembled, and in the end, I will be the one left standing. How familiar.
Of course I am confident. After all, everything in this world was made for mine convenience.

Hm? Of course, I punish them, according to their transgressions. Though it is rare for my expectations to be unfulfilled in the first place.
Obviously. As I said earlier, no one will follow a leader who can't even fend for themselves.
Hm. News sure move fast... but indeed, it is the truth.
Mine pride is fully justified, bird of ill omen. I deeply love those dear to me, and they love me in return. Can you say the same?
What is this "prom" you speak of? Explain yourself, commoner.
I do not stay idle all day, if that's what you are implying.
That you are unable to appreciate mine elegance tells more about you than about me, peasant.
Hm. Mine advice has already been given. There is nothing more to say.
While I have no practical use for obsolete, superstitious advice, you have proven entertaining thus far. Speak.
I will be, eventually. It's only suitable I dress the part.
Try as you might to sway my knight's loyalty. Surely, he will find the attempts as an amusing pastime.
I find it amusing that you think you would be the one kidnapping me, and not the other way around.
If I am to lose this round, I trust that I will benefit from this somehow. The universe works for my gain, after all.
Any child that is under your care is bound to develop issues. My advice is that you procure a good environment to raise him.

I would prefer if you did not bring my parents into this. I do not wish to think about them, especially not in this situation.
It is unfair to compare any woman's charms to mine. As frustrating as it can be, you will have to cherish her even with her shortcomings.

I know what my fate is and the battles I've fought to earn my victories, so I care little for the mockery of a monster.
An uneventful journey would be exceedingly boring. Because this world was made for my convenience, even these surprises are a part of fate.

Oh, I do not make distinction between those of lower and higher birth. They are all far beneath me.

Rejoice, for I shall grant you the opportunity to gaze upon me as I disrobe.

This contest is but a brief diversion for me.

Ah, I must congratulate you. You haven't made this game boring yet.
My turn? Watch closely, for this will be the last time you will have the chance to witness mineself stripping.
Regardless of my position, overlook me at your own peril. I am experienced in such contests of wit.
Though my situation may appear dire to the untrained eye, I shall not alter my plans.

To be pushed into this position... How amusing.
Of course the masses will support me. They will come to respect my might, if nothing else.
While I was born into privilege, I have also striven to go further. I am not a fool who aspires for a lifetime of idleness.

Such craven behavior! Have you no respect for your own country?

I have no need to be coddled by the likes of you.

You never know when you will have to defend yourself from an assassination, after all.
Which do you prefer, hmm?

If you think of me as a trophy to be won, you will be sorely disappointed.
It is only natural to be distracted while in my presence, is it not?
If you wish to be the recipient of mine attention, you will have to earn such a privilege.
I do hope you manage to surprise me somehow.
Will you make yourself memorable, or will you insist on your mediocrity?
Entertain or entice me, I do not care which.
Haven't you gawked enough? Now I shall receive my retribution.
Do you always play like that, or am I just bringing out your worst?
Careful, now. You might make me think you’re entertaining.
Go on, don't make me wait for too long...
Yes, you will suffice. Just make sure not to disappoint me.
It would be unbecoming for the defeated to order the victor. Yet it is a boon of the victor to offer mercy to those conquered, don't you think?
You might have defeated the main attraction, but the game still goes on. How shall it proceed?
Cease any novel ideas you might have. I have little patience left.
I have seen plenty today, peasant. You will have to put quite some effort to show me something worthwhile.
You, peasant? Well then.
If you think you can still change my opinion of you, now is your chance to try.
Did you really think you could go up against me and escape unscathed?
I could see a glimmer of hope in your eyes that you could escape your fate... How adorable.
Go on, girl. Try to impress me.
I don't particularly care which of you commoners loses, as long as you make it interesting.
Ah, it's you there. Will you show even a single alluring aspect, I wonder?
Go ahead. Your clumsy floundering will only serve to highlight mine beauty.
I'm not in the habit of overly celebrating meaningless victories.
No need to pout. Losing to someone as remarkable as me is unremarkable.
Victory tastes as sweet as I imagined. How utterly disappointing for you.
Though it is doubtful that you will be able to match my presence, it would be too boring if you didn't even try, commoner.
Ah, the spoils of victory...
Strive to put your very being into this, commoner. If you do that, even someone like you can produce something of interest.
Struggle as much as you want; it will only make watching you even more enjoyable.
The taste of victory is something I shall never grow tired of.
Look at that, it is mine victory again!
A curious game; the loser chooses their own punishment. What will you pick, peasant?
Your insipid clothing merits no further assessment, but your body might prove interesting.
Go ahead. Try and see if you can eclipse mine radiance.
At this point, do try not to be boring. Can you manage that much?
You have my undisputed attention; don't squander it.
I hope you know what to do in this situation, commoner.
Oh? Do you think you are worthy of being the object of my desire?
Even with stakes such as these, defeat leaves a faint distaste in my mouth. Make up for it, peasant.
After all I have shown today, outstaging me will be a tall task. But go ahead, try and fail. It may be entertaining.
Are you afraid of the inevitable comparisons between us when we are both naked?
Whatever you might try now shall pale in comparison to what I have already demonstrated.
The fewer people remain, the fiercer the competition becomes.
Disrobing after me won't be enough to outshine me.
A tie? My, I wasn't aware that such a thing could be possible...
If the one with the worst hand is bound to strip, then both losers should strip.
Whoever deals the cards should be punished for this misuse of my time.

An utter waste of everyone's time. And above all, a waste of my time.
I fail to see much value in a commoner's trinkets. Remove them quickly, at the very least.
Of course, the craftsmanship leaves much to be desired. But that is to be expected.
That shall do. For now...

Such a tedious display... But today I am in a good mood, so I shall allow it.
I have always failed to see the appeal of mediocrity.
My expectations were low, yet you managed to sink them even lower.
If your aim was to disappoint, you succeeded.
Am I to take this as a provocation?

Making you regret this shall be most satisfying.

I shall revel in your downfall, commoner. Mark my words.

Do your decisions serve any purpose other than making yourself look like a fool?
And this is meant to elicit my arousal?
Is there a point in removing so little each time? You lack the beauty for such subtle maneuvering, peasant.
This is far too late for such a jest, peasant.
How uninspired...

Hm. Few men would be willing to go as far as using makeup, yet the result is certainly striking.
Perhaps I should have brought Al here. At least he would know better than to bore me.
It is only natural to expect ordinary decisions from ordinary people.
We've wasted enough time. Shall we move on?

Was that really all you had to offer?
If nothing else, now I have accurately assessed you. No longer will I be blindsided by your boorishness.
Will you show anything meaningful, or is that expecting too much?
Is there truly a point to your struggles? Victory will not be yours, nor will you endear yourself to me with such tactics.
I shall look forward to your next defeat, peasant. And the next one, and the next one after that, until you lay naked at my feet.
"Like pearls before swine" would be an appropriate saying for this situation, were such a comparison fair to swine.
Fortunately, I have no trouble forgetting meaningless things. Like you, for example.
Such a performance merits no further comment.
It must be certainly insignificant, for you to part with it so easily.
Early skirmishes can only bring so much wealth to one's coffers.
Even if symbolic, this is no less of a victory.
Forgettable.
Was that the finest outfit you could bring? You must fire your tailor, if that is the case.
I understand being afraid to be outshone by my beauty, but at the very least make an attempt.
Trying to gain time by stalling with your ~clothing~? Don't tell me you're that intimidated by me...
It matters not how many turns you waste, my victory is inevitable.
Your defeat is already guaranteed, so why don't you revel in the time you have left? Let go of that self-restraint!
You really ought to be more aware of your surroundings...
Hiding behind your clothing will not bring you closer to victory, peasant.
Consider yourself fortunate that scathing remarks will be your sole punishment.
Are you aware of the nature of this game, ~target~? Or were you never taught manners even most commoners would know?

Such small items need not be removed. You would do well to learn from my example.
